selectionMethod: All home-service contractor client sites attributed by iMarket Solutions' public portfolio API, plus all contractor sites linked from WebFX's public HVAC-examples article; non-contractor links (seo.com, teamai.com, a VWO dev host) and one UK site (non-NANP) removed BEFORE freezing. NONRANDOM. WebFX picks are "best design" examples, which likely biases defect prevalence DOWN. Agency attribution is historical and not proof of the current agency.

preregistered.success: >= 2/40 sites (5%) with an independently corroborated sellable defect under R3 rules (typo-class phone mismatch, malformed tel link, form posting to a non-resolving host)

permissions: Read-only GET, robots respected, maxPages 3, no submissions, calls or contact
